question: When did the administration of the English East India Company in India come to an end?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1858**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The administration of the English East India Company in India came to an end in **1858**.
 
• This occurred after the **Indian Rebellion of 1857**, which led to significant changes in the governance of India.
 
• Following the rebellion, the British Crown took direct control of India, marking the start of the British Raj.
 
• The Government of India Act 1858 was enacted to transfer the powers of the East India Company to the British Crown.
 
• This act led to the establishment of the office of the Secretary of State for India, who was responsible for overseeing Indian affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian Rebellion of 1857**, also known as the First War of Indian Independence, was a major, but ultimately unsuccessful, uprising against the British East India Company's rule in India.
 
• The rebellion led to significant changes in the administration and governance of India.
 
• The British Crown's direct control over India lasted until India gained independence on **15th August 1947**.
 
• The transition from Company rule to Crown rule marked a significant shift in colonial governance, impacting India's political and social landscape.
